definitions.explanation: Rice that has been milled to remove the bran and germ, resulting in the familiar white grains commonly eaten in Japan.

examples.japanese: {白米|はくまい}を{炊飯器|すいはんき}で{炊|た}く。
examples.english: To cook white rice in a rice cooker.

examples.japanese: {日本人|にほんじん}の{主食|しゅしょく}は{白米|はくまい}だ。
examples.english: White rice is the staple food of Japanese people.

examples.japanese: {白米|はくまい}を{三合|さんごう}{研|と}ぐ。
examples.english: To wash three cups of white rice.
examples.notes: {研|と}ぐ means to rinse rice before cooking

notes:
USAGE:
{白米|はくまい} is polished rice, the most common form of rice eaten in Japan. The word {精白米|せいはくまい} is a more formal/technical term.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{白米|はくまい}を{炊|た}く (cook white rice)
・{白米|はくまい}を{研|と}ぐ (rinse white rice)
・{炊|た}きたての{白米|はくまい} (freshly cooked white rice)

RELATED TERMS:
・ご{飯|はん} (cooked rice - everyday word)
・{米|こめ} (uncooked rice - general)
・{精米|せいまい} (rice polishing/polished rice)
